notes: Floorplan-level listing, not a single unit. The page links a Matterport titled 'Unit #506 - 2 Bed/2 Bath' and describes the gallery as interior photos of the 2-Bedroom/2 Bath floorplan; the photos are probably of the same model unit, but the page does not say so. Square footage: the description says 700 sq ft, the spec line says 700 to 950 sq ft across units. Residents pay electricity, internet ($30/mo per person) and water/sewer ($50/mo per person). Amenities marked * are 'available for select units'. Captions are the site's image alt text. Floorplan is a 3D-rendered diagram with no dimensions.
